weeks.quality: Easy running only — no hard session this week.   RETURN WEEK. Everything easy, flat, soft surfaces where possible. Ankle rule all month: zero pain that changes your stride, and no swelling next morning.

Strides (Wed): Strides only — 4 reps of 20 sec.   Still rebuilding. Add 4 relaxed strides after one easy run. Daily single-leg calf raises + balance work start now (see Microcycle) — that's the ankle insurance.

Threshold (Wed): 6 reps of 2 min at threshold (Zone 4), 2 min jog.   Back at your old baseline. First quality session — modest on purpose. Every easy run stays true Zone 2: conversational, nose-breathing. Sat 14k = one lap of 'Lerbjerg fra Svanninge' (Wikiloc, 14.6 km / 500 m+) — Z2, hike the climbs, note the lap time.
Strides (Wed): Strides only — 6 reps of 20 sec.   DELOAD. Absorb the return. Sleep +1h, mobility daily. If the ankle has been quiet for 4 weeks, the rebuild worked.
Threshold (Wed): 8 reps of 2 min at threshold (Zone 4).   Volume climbs past the old normal. Fuel the long run with 40g carbs/hr — gut training starts now, not in January.

EVENT WEEK: Mammut March 50 km (Aarhus, Sat 3 Oct) replaced the long run — no threshold this week.   Done: 51 km / 11:03 total (9:28 moving) / 652 m+ / HR 95 avg, no drift. Lesson: 1:35 of stops — Bornholm budget is ~20 min total.

No quality (Wed) — recovery after Mammut March.   RECOVERY WEEK. Resting HR must be back near 49 by Thursday. Sat: first Svanninge — ONE lap of 'Lerbjerg fra Svanninge' (14.6 km / 500 m+) fully easy, hike every climb, poles from the first metre. If resting HR is still ≥52 on Thursday → 14 km flat in Odense instead. Wed PM legs: 2 light sets only.

Threshold (Wed): 8 × 2 min on 5–6% treadmill incline, HR 160–170, 2 min easy between.   Back into the build. Sat: Lerbjerg 1 lap + ~3 km out-and-back, poles all the way, 45–55 g carbs/hr. Wed PM legs: full session.

Threshold (Wed): 4 × 3 min at threshold, 2 min jog — shortened, race on Sunday.   RACE WEEK: Eventyrsport BakkeTrail 25 km, Svanninge, SUN 25 Oct. Train the first 20 km (hike every climb, HR <140, 60 g carbs/hr, full race kit + poles), race the last 5 only if the legs say yes. Sat: 5 km shakeout. Wed PM legs: 2 sets, no heavy eccentric calf work.
Tempo (Wed): 25 min tempo (Zone 3).   Closing the build block. Mon: REST after BakkeTrail. Long run 26k in Svanninge (~1.75 laps) — full fuelling rhythm, drink on a 20-min schedule.
Hills (Wed): Hill repeats 8 reps of 90 sec.   FIRST BACK-TO-BACK: Sat 28k + Sun 12k easy — running on tired legs is THE ultra skill. Power-hike the steep stuff on purpose.
Tempo (Wed): 2 reps of 15 min tempo (Zone 3).   Sat 30k / Sun 14k. It's dark by 16:30 now — do part of a weekend run with your headlamp. Race starts at 06:00 in the dark.
Tempo (Wed): Strides + 10 min tempo.   DELOAD. Down week — recover hard so the December weekends land.
Threshold (Wed): 6 reps of 3 min threshold on rolling hills.   Sat 32k / Sun 15k. Full winter kit test: layers, gloves, buff, headlamp. Learn what you sweat through and what you freeze in.
Race-pace (Wed): Race-pace 2 reps of 15 min.   Sat 35k / Sun 16k. Practise eating with cold hands — gels get stiff, zips get hard. 60g carbs/hr minimum now.
Tempo (Wed): Strides + 2 reps of 10 min tempo.   DELOAD before the two biggest weeks of the plan.
Threshold (Wed): 3 reps of 10 min threshold (Zone 4), 2 min jog.   Sat 38k / Sun 18k. Biggest training load of your life so far — protect sleep and eat at maintenance all week.
Tempo (Wed): 2 reps of 20 min tempo (Zone 3).   CHRISTMAS WEEK — use the holiday daylight: Sat 40k / Sun 20k, unhurried, daytime, fully fuelled. Peak weekly volume of the plan.

Race-pace (Wed): Race-pace 2 reps of 15 min.   DRESS REHEARSAL weekend: Sat 42k = 3 laps of the Lerbjerg loop (~1,500 m+) at Svanninge Bakker in full race kit, race fuelling (60-90g/hr), hills, part in the dark. Sun 15k shuffle. After this, the hay is in the barn.
Tempo (Wed): 2 reps of 12 min tempo (Zone 3).   Step down begins. Sat 26k / Sun 10k — last meaningful weekend. Book ferry/accommodation logistics now, not race week.
Race-pace (Wed): Race-pace 2 reps of 10 min.   Volume drops, legs sharpen. Test your complete race-day layering one more time on the Sat 20k.
Strides (Wed): Openers 4 reps of 2 min at race effort.   Deep taper. Carbs up, stress down, sleep banked. Lay out full kit + drop bag; charge headlamps, pack spare batteries.
Strides (Wed): Openers 3 reps of 1 min.   ★ HAMMER TRAIL WINTER 50 MILES (Sat 06:00). Start absurdly easy in the dark, hike every climb, eat from minute 30 and never stop. Then 2-3 weeks off running.
